from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEquity(BaseModel):
    """Equity value reported for one company in their financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    equity_value: float | None = Field(description="The equity attributable to parent company shareholders (归属于上市公司股东的所有者权益) in yuan")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024 Q1' or '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt showing the equity figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_equities: list[CompanyEquity]
